summary: Official local custody was verified, but no anonymous public parcel ID-plus-geometry service was exposed. No parcel sample is retained.
queryOutcomes: English and Chinese first-party discovery queries are recorded in the city record with actual result URLs. Both found official Shanwei/Haifeng registration and cadastral-survey evidence, not a public geometry API.
requestOutcomes: Four bounded anonymous HTTPS GET requests returned HTTP 200. They returned official procedure, custody, or information-request pages; none returned viewer JavaScript/configuration, parcel schema/CRS, or safe parcel ID-plus-geometry data.
routesAttempted: Official Shanwei Natural Resources Bureau Haifeng registration report
localRegistryCustodian: Haifeng County Natural Resources Bureau / Haifeng County property-registration center, evidenced by official Shanwei Natural Resources Bureau reports.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only, if independently confirmed
source layer and public service metadata
scopeLimits: A point miss, absent public viewer/API, inaccessible hidden system, or lack of a public sample is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence. No exact-point parcel query was treated as a coverage test.
uncertainty: A public Haifeng parcel viewer or service may exist behind an interactive or authenticated workflow; its endpoint, access rules, schema, CRS, native identity, and geographic coverage were not established.
